mapper.insert: INSERT INTO student (name, gender, age, school, grade_id, parent_contact, user_id) VALUES (#{name}, #{gender}, #{age}, #{school}, #{gradeId}, #{parentContact}, #{userId})
mapper.update: UPDATE student SET name = #{name}, gender = #{gender}, age = #{age}, school = #{school}, grade = #{grade}, contact = #{contact}, parent_contact = #{parentContact} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM student WHERE user_id = #{userId}
